SEARCH
Package photos.controller

Class SearchUtils

java.lang.Object
photos.controller.SearchUtils
public class SearchUtils extends Object
Utility class providing static helper methods for searching photos across all albums belonging to the currently logged-in user.

Searches may be performed by date ranges or by tags, with support for single-tag matching, AND-condition matching, or OR-condition matching.

All search operations scan every album owned by Photos.currentUser and collect matching photos without duplicates.
